crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Tax Structuring and Planning
children.blurb: Tax structuring and planning covers the design of legal entities, contracts, financing, and intellectual property ownership across jurisdictions to shape where income, deductions, credits, and gains are recognized.

children.name: Transfer Pricing
children.blurb: Transfer pricing is the set of rules and practices for setting and testing the prices charged in transactions between related entities that operate in different tax jurisdictions.

children.name: Research Credits from Engineering Records
children.blurb: Research credits from engineering records covers the use of engineering artifacts to support claims for research and development tax credits.

children.name: Sales, Use and Value Added Tax
children.blurb: Sales, use, and value added tax are transaction taxes that apply to the transfer of goods and services.

children.name: Audit Defence and Controversy
children.blurb: Audit defence and controversy covers the work of responding to tax authority inquiries, audits, assessments, appeals, and mutual agreement procedures across jurisdictions.

sections.body: Tax and jurisdictional compliance is the work of applying tax rules across borders to how a company is structured, how it prices internal transactions, how it claims credits, how it collects indirect tax, and how it defends positions under audit. AI is now used to read contracts, invoices, ledgers, and engineering records, extract relevant facts, classify transactions, and flag anomalies for human review. In transfer pricing, systems assemble comparable data and draft documentation from financial and operational records. In indirect tax, tools help determine taxability, rates, and reporting obligations from product and customer data. In audit defence, search and summarisation tools assemble timelines, evidence, and prior filings. The output is still a draft or a signal, not a filed position.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: The work stands at a point where data extraction, document classification, reconciliation, and anomaly detection are largely solved for clean, digital records. What is not solved is legal judgment, treaty interpretation, the weighing of facts and intent, and the final sign off on a tax position. Tax rules change by jurisdiction and by year, so a model trained on past filings can miss a new rule or a local practice. Confidentiality, privilege, and audit trails create real limits on what can be sent to an external model. The site tracks 222 compliance and regulation pages, which reflects how much of this field is documentation, process, and evidence rather than calculation alone. A human reviewer remains necessary for any position that carries penalty risk or public disclosure.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: The pages under this section fit together as a chain from planning to defence. Tax Structuring and Planning covers how entities, transactions, and intellectual property are arranged across jurisdictions. Transfer Pricing covers the pricing of intercompany transactions and the documentation that supports those prices. Research Credits from Engineering Records covers how technical and engineering records are used to substantiate research and development credit claims. Sales, Use and Value Added Tax covers indirect tax determination, collection, and reporting on goods and services. Audit Defence and Controversy covers the response to tax authority questions, assessments, and disputes, and a reader goes to each page for the specific records, tests, and review points that AI can support in that part of the compliance cycle.
